front_blocks.md: Define **transactional data**.

back_blocks.md: Transactional data is **data that is sent between two connected digital devices** on the internet, and it is **stored in cookies**.

cards.front_md: Define **transactional data**.
cards.back_md: Transactional data is **data that is sent between two connected digital devices** on the internet, and it is **stored in cookies**.

front_blocks.md: Define **cookie**.

back_blocks.md: A cookie is **information left on a user's device** so that a website can **recognise the user when they visit again**.

cards.front_md: Define **cookie**.
cards.back_md: A cookie is **information left on a user's device** so that a website can **recognise the user when they visit again**.

front_blocks.md: Name four kinds of data stored in a cookie.

back_blocks.md: The **time and date of the transaction**, the **IP address**, **data on products or services previously viewed or purchased**, **items added to a shopping cart**, **buttons pressed**, and **data entered into web forms**.

cards.front_md: Name four kinds of data stored in a cookie.
cards.back_md: The **time and date of the transaction**, the **IP address**, **data on products or services previously viewed or purchased**, **items added to a shopping cart**, **buttons pressed**, and **data entered into web forms**.

front_blocks.md: Name the three types of cookie.

back_blocks.md: **Session cookies**, **persistent cookies** and **third-party cookies**.

cards.front_md: Name the three types of cookie.
cards.back_md: **Session cookies**, **persistent cookies** and **third-party cookies**.

front_blocks.md: What makes a session cookie temporary?

back_blocks.md: It is **lost when you close the browser**, which is why it is considered **less of a privacy concern**.

cards.front_md: What makes a session cookie temporary?
cards.back_md: It is **lost when you close the browser**, which is why it is considered **less of a privacy concern**.

front_blocks.md: Name three things session cookies are used for.

back_blocks.md: **Keeping track of shopping carts**, **remembering login status** and **form inputs**.

cards.front_md: Name three things session cookies are used for.
cards.back_md: **Keeping track of shopping carts**, **remembering login status** and **form inputs**.

front_blocks.md: How is a persistent cookie different from a session cookie?

back_blocks.md: A persistent cookie is **stored on a local storage device** and has an **expiration date set by the website**, ranging from days to years.

cards.front_md: How is a persistent cookie different from a session cookie?
cards.back_md: A persistent cookie is **stored on a local storage device** and has an **expiration date set by the website**, ranging from days to years.

front_blocks.md: Name three things persistent cookies are used for.

back_blocks.md: **Remembering login details for future visits**, **tracking browsing history**, and the **delivery of targeted advertising**.

cards.front_md: Name three things persistent cookies are used for.
cards.back_md: **Remembering login details for future visits**, **tracking browsing history**, and the **delivery of targeted advertising**.

front_blocks.md: Who owns a third-party cookie?

back_blocks.md: It does **not belong to the website visited** — it is owned by **third parties that provide services to the website**, such as social networking sites and advertising networks.

cards.front_md: Who owns a third-party cookie?
cards.back_md: It does **not belong to the website visited** — it is owned by **third parties that provide services to the website**, such as social networking sites and advertising networks.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Session cookies are a bigger privacy concern than third-party cookies.

back_blocks.md: **False.**

**Third-party** cookies are the bigger privacy concern because they **create a much larger profile of a user**; session cookies are considered less of a concern because they are lost when the browser closes.

back_blocks.md: Targeted marketing is when **third-party cookie data is used to match people** based on their **browsing history or personal attributes**.

front_blocks.md: What determines whether an online or a local service is better for a user?

front_blocks.md: Give four advantages of online services.

back_blocks.md: **Convenience**, with no travelling and use anytime, anywhere; **selection**, with a wider variety of local, national and international options; **competitive prices**, since online stores have lower costs; and **reviews and ratings** to read before purchasing.

cards.front_md: Give four advantages of online services.

front_blocks.md: Give four disadvantages of online services.

back_blocks.md: **Security** risks from online scams, fraud and data breaches; **returns and exchanges** are inconvenient, especially for bigger items; **delayed gratification** while waiting for items; and **limited customer service** that is impersonal or hard to reach.

front_blocks.md: Give four advantages of local services.
